payload.claim: A second person cannot download this as a plugin today and have the CLI work on another project.
payload.basis: No git remote, marketplace, pip package, or plugin bin/. Skills invoke python3 tools/artifacts.py in the consuming project cwd. design-artifacts does not plant the CLI. Hooks only find tools/artifacts.py if the full tree (tools/ + design/contracts/) is the plugin root.
payload.invalidated_when: the CLI is on PATH from the plugin (bin/ or equivalent) and skills invoke that copy with --root, or design-artifacts plants a working CLI, and there is a published install path
